visual_grammar.medium_handling: Drypoint/etching and hard black lithographic line with cold blue-grey washes, architectural graphite, and sparse sharp white paper left exposed.
visual_grammar.composition: Vertical, angular, aspirational structures—towers, stairs, cliffs, spires, profiles, and narrow shafts—organized through upward thrust and opposition.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Hard etched contours, acute angles, brittle crosshatch, dark architectural silhouettes, and abrupt white cuts.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Stark black/white and cold blue-grey contrast with few warm notes; bright values feel won against resistance.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Low or eye-level views that exaggerate height and distance, or severe profile compositions that isolate the aspiring figure from the horizontal city.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Precision gathers on masonry, books, faces in profile, stairs, battlements, and intellectual objects; surrounding space stays severe.
visual_grammar.finish: Austere, heroic, overdetermined, slightly hostile—the print language of aspiration becoming fortification.

visual_grammar.medium_handling: Flowing lithographic crayon and warm ink wash with circular pen tracery, gold/indigo spot color, map-lines, labyrinth curves, and gently rubbed plate tone.
visual_grammar.composition: Circles, loops, routes, keys, knots, recurring paths, and warm city wandering; the eye travels around and through rather than colliding with a wall.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Curved continuous line, repeated arcs, soft intersections, rounded enclosures, and paths that rejoin themselves.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Warm mid-values, earth and gold against deep blue, with luminous small openings rather than stark heroic contrast.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Human-scale street, room, or route views, often oblique or map-like enough to reveal recurrence while keeping embodied presence.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Detail follows routes, hands, ordinary objects, keys, food, shops, signs, and repeated civic motifs; no single emblem monopolizes the field.
visual_grammar.finish: Patient, cyclical, humane, and archetypal without leaving ordinary Dublin—the mythic discovered by flowing with the day.

visual_grammar.medium_handling: Dirty newsprint, charcoal, rough pen, overprinted type, smeared ink, tangled crosshatch, and muddy green-brown wash with visible corrections and abrasion.
visual_grammar.composition: Compressed rooms, crowded streets, overlapping obligations, tangled arguments, nets, bedding, wires, and diagonals that trap rather than release the eye.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Irregular scratch, snagged line, knotting, overprint, crushed margins, and forms partially occluded by other forms or text.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Muddy low-to-mid values with dingy greys, green-browns, tobacco tones, and hard local black; highlights are scarce and uncomfortable.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Close, cramped, off-axis human views or street-level congestion; very little clean distance is granted.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Detail accumulates in debris, clothing, ashplants, type, faces, bedding, theological/social clutter, and petty material frictions.
visual_grammar.finish: Hung-over, entangled, comic-grotesque, and materially uncomfortable—the mundane felt as something that catches on you.

visual_grammar.medium_handling: Soft colored lithography and ink wash warmed by crayon/pencil rubbing, flesh and food tones, domestic paper textures, and rounded hand-drawn contour.
visual_grammar.composition: Organic close interiors and inhabited ordinary spaces—kitchens, baths, beds, tables, cats, bodies, meals—organized around comfort, appetite, care, and practical gesture.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Rounded soft contours, gently broken domestic line, fabric/flesh/steam edges, and warm overlapping forms rather than rigid boundaries.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Warm browns, pinks, cream, buttery yellow, soft black, and domestic shadow; mid-values dominate with localized tactile highlights.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Close-to-medium human/body scale, usually eye-level within the room or at the table; the viewer inhabits rather than surveys the ordinary.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: High tactile detail in hands, skin, food, utensils, fabric, cats, beds, steam, and small acts of practical kindness; background architecture remains secondary.
visual_grammar.finish: Embodied, tender, comic, sensual, and unheroic—the warm material intelligence of living well enough in the day.
avoid: precious decorative prettiness that sanitizes bodily life
